'''Yoshitsugu Matsuoka''' (Japanese: '''松岡禎丞''' ''Matsuoka Yoshitsugu'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Matsuoka was born on September 17, 1986 in {{wp|Obihiro}}, {{wp|Hokkaido}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, replacing [[Tatsuhisa Suzuki]] as Galar Gym Leader [[Raihan]].
